description:
"In my world there is only one moon, no two moons like that." Seol sat up looking up at the night sky.   
"From the start, there were two moons. No world has only one," replied Cerizar.   
"Then, my existence also doesn't exist huh." Seol pursed his lips with a frown on his face.   
At that moment Cerizar immediately jumped in front of Seol.   
"Aren't you in front of me now?" Deg! Seol's heart suddenly skipped a beat.   
Does that mean Seol has feelings for Cerizar?
